report:
MRI of knee was performed in sagittal, axial and coronal sections. Spin echo sequence are used.

> Stauts of nerve sheath ganglion in popliteal area post excision biopsy
*  A space-occupying lesion with lobulated apperance and internal septums in lateral posterior compartment of distal thigh to popliteal fossa, between biceps muscle and semitendinosus muscle,it is hyposignal intensity in T1WI & hypersignal intensity in T2WI, liquid in nature is considered, in favor of residural ganglion cyst along sciatic nerve and its branches, more than 12 cm in length.
* There are linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, without significant extends into the surface, R/O grade 2 intrasubstance signal.

> No significant bone marrow edema or active cortical destruction noted at distal femur and proximal tibia and fibula in this study.
> No significant myositis noted at distal thights to proximal legs.
> The contour of ACL & PCL appear to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> No evidence of bone contusion is noted.

Impression: Nerve sheath ganglion in popliteal area S/P excision biopsy; in favor of residural nerve sgheath ganglion cyst in popliteal fossa (along sciatic nerve and its branches) without significant interval change in the scan field in comparison with last MR on  [DATE].

Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation and follow up.
